ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到与任何人都不亲密了吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel that you are no longer close to anyone?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到与周围人的关系和谐吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel that you are ‘in tune’ with the people around you?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到想要与人来往、结交朋友吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel outgoing and friendly?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到没有人很了解你吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel that no one really knows you well?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到有人愿意与你交谈吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel that there are people you can talk to?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到寂寞吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel alone?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到有人值得你信赖吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel that there are people you can turn to?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到与人亲近吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel close to people?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到与别人隔开了吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel isolated from others?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到与周围的人有许多共同点吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel that you have a lot in common with the people around you?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到你与别人来往毫无意义吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel that your relationships with others are not meaningful?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到被人冷落吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel left out?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到属于朋友们中的一员吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel part of a group of friends?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到人们围着你但并不关心你吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel that people are around you but not with you?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到缺少伙伴吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel that you lack companionship?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到羞怯吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel shy?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到没人可以信赖吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel that there is no one you can turn to?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到有人真正了解你吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel that there are people who really understand you?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到你的兴趣与想法与周围的人不一样吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel that your interests and ideas are not shared by those around you?

ucla3.item_text_zh: 你常感到当你愿意时就能找到伙伴吗？
ucla3.item_text_en: How often do you feel you can find companionship when you want it?

gad7.item_text_zh: 感到似乎将有可怕的事情发生而害怕
gad7.item_text_en: Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still

gad7.item_text_zh: 对各种各样的事情担忧过多
gad7.item_text_en: Worrying too much about different things

gad7.item_text_zh: 不能够停止或控制担忧
gad7.item_text_en: Not being able to stop or control worrying
Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge

phq9.item_text_zh: 动作或说话速度缓慢到别人已经察觉，或正好相反——烦躁或坐立不安、动来动去的情况更胜于平常
phq9.item_text_en: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite - being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Feeling tired or having little energy

phq9.item_text_zh: 做事时提不起劲或没有兴趣
phq9.item_text_en: Little interest or pleasure in doing things

phq9.item_text_zh: 感到心情低落、沮丧或绝望
对事物专注有困难，例如阅读报纸或看电视时不能集中注意力
phq9.item_text_en: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television

phq9.item_text_zh: 入睡困难、睡不安稳或睡眠过多
phq9.item_text_en: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much

phq9.item_text_zh: 觉得自己很糟，或觉得自己很失败，或让自己、家人失望
phq9.item_text_en: Feeling bad about yourself - or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down

phq9.item_text_zh: 有不如死掉或用某种方式伤害自己的念头
phq9.item_text_en: Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way
